text: A rank-16 Factorization Machine with Adam-style sparse updates using user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, and duration_bucket reproduces the official baseline within seed noise: 0.6028 versus 0.6016 (+0.0012), making it a suitable control but not a measurable improvement.

On the nine stable categorical inputs, validation selected an epoch-2 DeepFM/incumbent rank blend with 0.50 weight on DeepFM, but its 0.6043 primary is only +0.0015 over the FM control; the tested additive memorization, expanded-FM, DeepFM, and original DCN candidates therefore produced no measurable ranking gain.

The tested recency-weighted empirical-Bayes personalization and rank-space blending add no measurable value over the 0.6043 incumbent: the selected 0.80 incumbent/0.20 empirical-Bayes blend scored 0.6043 raw, while the external 0.50 blend scored 0.6045, a difference of only +0.0002.

Within the tested boosted-tree setup, recency weighting improved the script-level binary model from 0.4597 to 0.5518 and recent LambdaRank reached 0.5569, but all tested tree variants remained far below the approximately 0.6043 incumbent and are not competitive in their current form.

Iteration 4 remains invalid evidence because it used validation-row post-click auxiliary outcomes as prediction inputs; post-click signals from scored rows are leakage, although train-row post-click signals may be used as auxiliary targets.

In the leakage-free, user-balanced iteration-5 comparison using post-click signals only as train-row auxiliary targets, none of latent FM, PNN, AutoInt, or MMoE measurably improved the 0.6045 trusted incumbent, so the selector retained the incumbent with zero candidate weight.

Within the iteration-5 setup, latent FM (0.5977), PNN (0.6000), and AutoInt (0.6012) underperformed the 0.6045 incumbent by more than the 0.002 noise threshold, while MMoE (0.6028) was only 0.0017 lower and is statistically indistinguishable rather than evidence of harm or benefit.

In iteration 6, field-weighted FM (0.5972), numeric DCNv2 (0.601745), and numeric FiBiNET (0.601238) each scored more than 0.002 below the 0.6045 trusted incumbent, so these tested configurations measurably underperformed and the selector correctly retained the incumbent with zero candidate weight.
The three most recent accepted scored iterations (3, 5, and 6) produced no gain above 0.002 over the incumbent, so the stipulated three-consecutive-no-gain stopping condition has been reached.
